page_note: Page divides cleanly into two halves. Segs 0-16 are cosmological substrate teaching about the Greatness of Light, the brother's commandment/parangelia, the enemy-king of single principle, the kingdom that has left its Deep, the scattering of Darkness, and the structural relation between the first-Light kingdom and the kingdom of this cosmos (whose fellow-mysteries either agree with her or transgress and perish). Seg 17 pivots explicitly with 'According to this comparison, you yourselves' (ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲓⲧⲁⲛⲧⲛ ⲛ̄ⲧⲱⲧⲛ̄) — a textbook hortatory pivot — and segs 17-26 apply the cosmological pattern to the audience as conditional exhortation about Sin. Editorial fatigue score (+1.74) reflects exactly this structural shift. Damage is heavy in the lower half (54.8%).
